_comment: Published results for this ablation, as reported at https://aiscientist.tools/posts/labbench-benchmark . Accuracies are percentages, averaged over 3 repetitions, on Biomni's released test split (DbQA 60 items, SeqQA 70 items). Compare a reproduction against these; agreement within a couple of points is expected, since agent runs are not deterministic.

protocol.items: Biomni released test split, same items and same option construction
protocol.grading: exact letter match on [ANSWER]X[/ANSWER]; unparseable or refused answers count as incorrect
protocol.conditions: identical agent, model, prompts and code execution; ToolUniverse presence is the only difference

notes: Biomni's published accuracies are on these identical items, which makes it a same-item reference point rather than a re-implementation. It runs on its own base model, so the gap against it also contains a base-model difference; the with/without ablation is the measurement that holds the model constant.
Opus 4.8 declines a small number of questions on safety grounds in both conditions, and a declined answer is scored incorrect. The Claude Code accuracies are therefore lower bounds.
